subject: Deadline tip: outline tonight, draft tomorrow
preview: Split the work so 2am-you isn't inventing structure.
body: {{first_name}}, if a deadline is close, don't try to write and structure in one sitting.

Tonight: research question + outline only.
Tomorrow: generate sections from that outline.
That split is how people stop rewriting the intro five times.
Research Generator is free to try for the outline step — no card required.
If writing isn't on your plate this week, ignore this. If it is — get the outline done before the deadline owns you.
P.S. Worst case: 3 minutes and you learn it isn't for you. Best case: you sleep.
